html:
G'oya

Har quyishda shu mashinaning oxirgi uchta qatori kerak. Bu freym: ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW. Shu freym ustida litrlar va km larni alohida yig'amiz va birini ikkinchisiga bo'lamiz. Dastlabki quyishlarda freym qisqaroq bo'ladi, buni window funksiya o'zi hal qiladi.

Yechim

SELECT truck, day,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(liters) OVER w / SUM(km) OVER w, 2) AS l_per_100km
FROM refuels
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY truck ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

WINDOW w AS (...) bir xil oynani ikki marta yozmaslik uchun: PostgreSQL ham, SQLite ham uni tushunadi. 30 A 512 KA ning 6-kungi qatorida uchta quyish bor: (60 + 90 + 75) / (200 + 410 + 300) × 100 = 24.73.

Tuzoqlar

Har quyish sarfining o'rtachasi. Masalada aytilgandek bu boshqa son beradi: 200 km dagi quyish ham, 410 km dagi quyish ham bir xil og'irlik oladi. Namunada 6-kun uchun 24.73 o'rniga 25.65 chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT truck, day,
       ROUND(AVG(100.0 * liters / km) OVER (PARTITION BY truck ORDER BY day
                                           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS l_per_100km
FROM refuels

RANGE BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING qatorlarni emas, day qiymatlarini sanaydi: 10-kun uchun faqat 8, 9 va 10-kunlar. Mashina har kuni quymaydi, shuning uchun bunday freymda ko'pincha bitta quyish qoladi.

Freymni umuman yozmaslik ham xato: ORDER BY bor oynada standart freym boshidan joriy qatorgacha, ya'ni mashinaning butun tarixi.
